course: Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things
assignment_title: Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things Week 6 Assignment

questions.question: Which of the following is highlighted as a benefit of sensor usage in industrial applications for improving overall operations?
Which type of sensor is primarily used for the inspection of steel pipes and detecting time-varying stresses or strains in ferromagnetic materials?
The DS1621 temperature sensor is a digital sensor that communicates via an I2C bus and generates temperature data of how many bits?
In the context of gas sensor characteristics, how is 'Selectivity' defined?

options.a: The ability to detect a particular gas in a mixture of different gases
options.b: The time taken to stabilize its response
options.c: The change in output signal with respect to unit change in input
options.d: The ability to return to its base resistance value

questions.correct_answer: The ability to detect a particular gas in a mixture of different gases

questions.question: What happens to the resistance of an n-type metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) gas sensor when it is exposed to a reducing gas?
How many active connections or sockets does the ModBus-TCP protocol typically support at one time?
In EtherNet/IP, which primary type of communication is used to handle real-time I/O data through continuous message transfer?
Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) is an extension of Ethernet developed to enable deterministic communication. Which IEEE standard is it primarily based on?
In a Profibus DP (Decentralized Peripherals) network, how many devices are supported at a single time without the use of repeaters?
What is the global operating frequency utilized by the CC-Link communication protocol?
The DeviceNet communication protocol links industrial sensors and actuators with Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and is based on which standard?
Which of the following is an advantage of the WIA-PA (Wireless Networks for Industrial Automation-Process Automation) standard?

options.a: It operates exclusively on wired fiber optics
options.c: It removes the need for data packet aggregation

questions.question: For Ultra-Reliable Low Latency Communication (URLLC) in 5G, what is the specified target for availability?
Which of the following is an objective of Device-to-Device (D2D) Communication in cellular networks?

options.a: Increasing the load on the core network
options.b: Eliminating the load on the core network

questions.correct_answer: Eliminating the load on the core network

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a primary disadvantage of millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication?

options.a: It requires huge antenna element sizes
options.b: It utilizes the heavily congested <1 GHz band
options.c: It suffers from high penetration loss and shadowing
options.d: It provides very low data throughput

questions.correct_answer: It suffers from high penetration loss and shadowing
